robustness.method: 36 weather/time/profile changes with three simulated seconds per cycle and real render/readback; bounded renderer resources; explicit sky/cloud/rain/fauna/events disposal. Not a prolonged walk or JS-heap leak proof.

method: 960×640 Chromium SwiftShader, exact same station and effective UTC dates before/after; simulation held; 240×1s settling per case, 6 forced GPU readback samples per case. Submission/readback wall time is not hardware FPS. Baseline has no cloudy/storm modes: overcast/rain used explicitly.
